title: myrrhodes cerefolium
intro: Myrrhodes cerefolium, commonly known as Wild Chamomile, is a flowering plant native to Australia. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including reducing anxiety and promoting relaxation due to its sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of Myrrhodes cerefolium include soothing digestive issues and alleviating menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
